# Copilot Instructions

- Make requested code changes directly in the repository.
- Preserve existing APIs unless the user explicitly requests an API change.
- Follow the repository’s existing conventions and architecture.
- Keep changes focused and avoid unrelated edits.
- Add or update tests for behavioral changes.
- Run relevant validation when available.
- Do not add dependencies without a clear need.
- If a requirement is ambiguous, choose the smallest reasonable implementation and state the assumption.
